extraction_notes: The supplied public PDF is an image-based International Rectifier datasheet marked IRFP064NPbF; the requested MPN is normalized to IRFP064NPBF.
The transfer and output curves were digitized from the Tj or Tc = 25 degC figures. Output-curve x and y axes are logarithmic; transfer-curve y axis is logarithmic.

Published table semantics retained: V(BR)DSS = 55 V minimum at VGS = 0 V and ID = 250 uA; VGS(th) = 2.0 V minimum and 4.0 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = 250 uA; RDS(on) = 0.008 ohm maximum at VGS = 10 V and ID = 59 A.

Capacitance table values are typical: Ciss = 4000 pF at VGS = 0 V, Coss = 1300 pF at VDS = 25 V, and Crss = 480 pF at VGS = 0 V and f = 1 MHz. Figure 5 was digitized separately for the voltage dependence.

Body-diode table values include VSD = 1.3 V maximum at IS = 59 A, VGS = 0 V, Tj = 25 degC; trr = 110 ns typical and 170 ns maximum at Tj = 25 degC and IF = 59 A; Qrr = 450 nC typical and 680 nC maximum at di/dt = 100 A/us.
Gate charge table values include Qg = 70 nC typical at ID = 59 A, Qgs = 32 nC typical at VDS = 44 V, and Qgd = 74 nC typical at VDS = 10 V; these are not represented by the strict extraction schema.
Thermal ratings: RthetaJC = 0.75 degC/W maximum, RthetaCS = 0.24 degC/W typical, and RthetaJA = 40 degC/W maximum. Tj operating range is -55 to +175 degC.
Off-state leakage table values: IDSS maximum 25 uA at VDS = 55 V, VGS = 0 V, and 250 uA at VDS = 44 V, VGS = 0 V, Tj = 150 degC. Gate leakage is +100/-100 nA maximum at VGS = +20/-20 V.
